name: armis-knowledge-skills-stage
description: STAGE environment (knowledge-api.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-stage, /cwe-fix-stage, /framework-guidance-stage, and /tech-guidance-stage as shell skills that call the backend directly. Reads ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_CLIENT_ID and ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_TENANT_SLUG; loads client_secret from the OS keychain (service: armis-knowledge-stage). Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
